environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e) in VPC vpc-9d8e7f6a, subnet-public-1a. Instance has IAM role 'ContactFormServiceRole' with SES SendEmail and SendRawEmail permissions. Security group sg-0abc123 allows outbound TCP/25 to 10.0.0.0/8 (internal SMTP relay at smtp.internal.corp). No network ACL restrictions on SMTP traffic. Application runs as container on ECS with task role allowing full SMTP relay access. The internal SMTP relay (postfix) at smtp.internal.corp accepts messages without authentication and forwards based on envelope headers.

config.smtp_relay: postfix on smtp.internal.corp, open relay for internal VPC sources
